semiconductor_relevance: High — Space Solutions specializes in manufacturing welded metal bellows and fluid control components that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Space Solutions Co., Ltd. is a South Korean manufacturer specializing in welded metal bellows and fluid control components, which are essential for various semiconductor applications. Established in 2000, the company focuses on delivering high-quality products for the semiconductor, display, defense, and aerospace industries.

regional_presence.Korea: The company is based in South Korea and has been manufacturing industrial bellows since 2003.
